skill.name: DPN AI Image & Vision Studio v6
skill.description: Generate, edit, analyze, validate, and iteratively improve image assets with backend-aware routing and evidence-based completion.
instructions: Use plan_image_vision_mission for non-trivial image generation, editing, analysis, or iterative refinement requests.
For edits or analysis, inspect reference images before changing anything; do not invent a reference that is not present.
Prefer the configured local image backend when available. If another backend is selected or used as fallback, report that explicitly.
Preserve requested identity, composition, branding, dimensions, text, aspect ratio, and style constraints from reference material.
When generating, produce a clear positive prompt, negative prompt where supported, reproducible seed metadata, and an exact output path.
After generation, verify that the file exists and can be decoded as an image before claiming success.
Use vision analysis when available to compare the produced image against the user's requirements. Treat the comparison as evidence, not as a completion claim by itself.
If defects are found, refine prompts or settings and rerender only within the plan's bounded iteration budget.
Stop early when the output meets the required quality gates; do not iterate merely to consume the full budget.
Do not claim pixel-perfect, identity-preserving, or text-perfect results without evidence supporting that statement.
Return final image paths, backend, seed, validation notes, and any limitations or unmet requirements.
